answer: Tundra-gate arrival spacing: each identity must submit its first request after a randomized hold, then wander across at least three distinct ingress paths before gaining full throughput. The gateway records inter-arrival variance per identity; flat, bursty timing gets throttled to a terrace of low-priority queues. Sybils pay by needing parallel, staggered scheduling infrastructure and forced idle time per fake identity, multiplying coordination cost and slowing each from useful work.
